item.title: ‘One Battle After Another’ and ‘Sinners’ Win Top Prizes at 2026 WGA Awards (Full Winners List)
item.description: "The Pitt" has won three WGA Awards, including Best Drama and Best New Series.

item.title: ‘Sinners,’ ‘Frankenstein,’ and ‘Sirât’ Among 2026 Golden Reel Award Winners from MPSE
item.description: Kathleen Kennedy and "Mad Max: Fury Road" supervising sound editor Mark Mangini both won honorary awards.

item.title: 2026 ASC Award Winners Include ‘One Battle After Another’ and ‘2000 Meters to Andriivka’
item.description: On the TV side, the American Society of Cinematographers honored both "Task" and "Andor," as well as "Black Rabbit" and "The Studio."

item.title: What’s It Like to Be a Hair and Fur Fabricator for Laika? A New Book Will Answer That (and More)
item.description: Exclusive: A new book goes deep into not just the history of the beloved stop-motion animation studio, but the creative minds behind it.

item.title: ‘Mile End Kicks’ Trailer: Barbie Ferreira Takes a Wonderfully Relatable Trip Back to the Early Aughts
item.description: In Chandler Levack's latest, the actress stars as a budding music critic who moves to Montreal in the thick of an indie music boom. Will she find herself, or just good music? (Why not both?)

item.title: How ‘Marshals’ Director Greg Yaitanes Returned to His Procedural Roots for the ‘Yellowstone’ Spinoff
item.description: The prolific director of streaming and cable hits like "House of the Dragon" and "Presumed Innocent" tells IndieWire about coming back to network TV for the first time in over a decade for CBS' "Yellowstone" spinoff.

item.title: ‘Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze’ Turns 35: The Director on Vanilla Ice, and the Movie’s Return to Theaters
item.description: Director Michael Pressman looks back at working with Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello, and Michelangelo — and Vanilla Ice — on the 1991 sequel.

item.title: Don’t Let ‘The Bride!’ Box Office Bomb Give the Wrong Lesson About Ambition and Originality
item.description: With just $13.5 million globally against an $80 million production budget, Maggie Gyllenhaal's film is shaping up to be one of the bigger flops of 2026.

item.title: ‘The Super Mario Galaxy Movie’ Trailer: Chris Pratt, Charlie Day, and Anya Taylor-Joy Reprise Roles in Sequel to 2023 Smash Hit
item.description: Donald Glover has also been revealed as the voice of Yoshi in the video game adaptation, which opens on April Fools' Day.

item.title: All 30 Pixar Movies Ranked, from ‘Toy Story’ to ‘Elio’
item.description: See where classics like "The Incredibles," "Finding Nemo," and "WALL-E" rank alongside newer fare like "Soul," "Onward," "Turning Red," and "Inside Out 2" on IndieWire's list of the best films from the animation studio.
